name: Voussoir
description: Arch stones fanning out: each wedge leans a fixed step further than the column before it, so a row closes like an arch.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(26% 4%, 74% 4%, 96% 96%, 4% 96%); clip-path: polygon(26% 4%, 74% 4%, 96% 96%, 4% 96%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc((@x - (@X + 1) / 2) * 30 / @X)deg); transform: rotate(@calc((@x - (@X + 1) / 2) * 30 / @X)deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
